goal: Look up the member given by memberNumber and report the current balance and available balance of the share account given by shareType.

outcome.message: Discovery escalated to a human operator: The session timed out and the system is requesting Operator ID and Password on the SESSION EXPIRED SCREEN SEC-0900. I am not permitted to invent or enter credentials that were not provided as parameters, and no operator credentials were supplied. A human operator needs to sign back on (enter Operator ID and Password and submit Sign On) to restore an authenticated session; once logged in, I can resume the workflow to search for member «pii:2a94040b…0482», open their Share Accounts, and read the current and available balance for the SPECIAL SAVINGS share.
